openQuestions.text: Which internal contradictions or cross-phase inconsistencies exist between the nine phase specs and ADR-002?

resolvedQuestions.text: Which acceptance criteria are untestable or unfalsifiable (no threshold, no objective check, no exit-status contract)?
Which mechanisms are NAMED but not DEFINED (containment primitive, Serve identity signal, SQLite/migration choice, diff-truth model, reconnect reconciliation corner cases)?
Which edge cases and failure modes are unhandled (crash points, TOCTOU/races, offline/stale, multi-device, revocation, key rotation, push platform limits, iOS)?
Which security or privacy holes remain in the loopback/tailnet/foreground/redaction posture?

keyFindings.label: sync.delta/snapshot/gap named but never defined as message schemas
keyFindings.remediation: Add REQ-010 to 003 defining sync.* request/response contracts with idempotency and bounds

keyFindings.label: Diff-truth model undefined: monotonic envelopes vs mutable draft→terminal replacement
keyFindings.remediation: Add REQ-011 to 003 or REQ-010 to 005 defining the projection/reduction function and contentId keying

keyFindings.label: Snapshot-apply vs live-delta interleaving race on reconnect unhandled
keyFindings.remediation: Add REQ-012 to 005 with coversThrough barrier protocol

keyFindings.label: Epoch bump never coupled to revocation/lease invalidation
keyFindings.remediation: Add REQ-013 to 003 forcing epoch bump on revocation/rotation

keyFindings.label: approval.decide channel conflicts with commands-never-replayed-as-events invariant
keyFindings.remediation: Add REQ-014 to 006 separating decide (command channel) from requested/result (envelope events)

keyFindings.label: Redaction metadata schema and render-safe approval-card representation unspecified
keyFindings.remediation: Add ADR-004/REQ-015 to 006 defining canonical redaction function and render-safe action binding

keyFindings.label: causedBy cardinality/eligibility-flag lifecycle and ledger linkage undefined
keyFindings.remediation: Add REQ-016 to 003 fixing causedBy cardinality and tombstone semantics

keyFindings.label: Authenticated Serve identity signal mechanism undefined; loopback binding does not prevent local spoofing
keyFindings.remediation: Add ADR-005 to 004: unix-socket/peer-credential + per-deployment ephemeral secret

keyFindings.label: QR enrollment lacks challenge TTL, host-to-device mutual auth, partial-enrollment recovery
Device-key rotation absent; only push-subscription rotation covered
Multi-device management has no surface: no inventory, per-device revocation, remote-kill
One-use WebSocket tickets lack TTL, renewal, and reconnect semantics
iOS push limits unquantified; lock-screen attention class is a covert activity signal
Origin allowlist scope incomplete; Origin:null and PWA scope handling unspecified
Containment primitive named but never defined; escape tests unfalsifiable without it
keyFindings.remediation: Add ADR-007 to 006 pinning first containment primitive + decision gate

keyFindings.label: TOCTOU digest recompute and extension hook finality asserted, not proven; bypass path undefined
Lease/CAS lack TTL, expiry kill/drain, restart reconciliation with mutation ledger
keyFindings.remediation: Add REQ-024 to 006 + chaos-lane crash test

keyFindings.label: Kill switch boolean with no partial-disable or in-flight semantics; 009 stage gating not linked
Accept-edits grant lacks one-action boundary, epoch invalidation, deny-beats-grant race
Audit metadata lacks retention, query contract, tamper-evidence
WebAuthn/passkey step-up is an unowned orphan: no phase owns enrollment/recovery/fallback
Fail-closed used as criterion everywhere with no defined closed state or observable
REQ-090 version-pinned evidence has no schema, mechanism, or validation gate
Performance criteria name metrics but no targets; measured-without-bound is unfalsifiable
Documentation criteria process-shaped; 'tested on the target host' without a test runner
Supported-matrix rows have no completeness contract; empty matrix satisfies letter
Crash points enumerated but outcome vocabulary undefined; 'asserted durable outcome' circular
Universal-quantifier success claims (every bypass path, no hidden blocker) unfalsifiable
Offline read-only cache has no retention/eviction/revocation-clear contract
Redaction boundary list not closed; misses devtools, crash dumps, OS backups
Session catalog data minimization unspecified beyond opaque ids
Retention floors have no defaults/max and never reconcile replay/ledger/cache
Backup/restore ownership undefined; restore-to-new-host device-key lockout
Multi-device concurrent steering has no serialization or precondition vocabulary
No incident playbooks for new failure classes (indeterminate mutation, lease expiry, lockout, sync stall)
